Second preview of **EatPoint**, a fork of [OpenNutriTracker](https://github.com/simonoppowa/OpenNutriTracker) that counts food in points.

> **Preview build.** Installs as its own app (`io.github.grohle.eatpoint`), not on Google Play or the App Store yet. It updates 0.1.0 in place.

## What's new

**Your meals, your way**
- Add as many meals as you eat in a day (mid-morning, afternoon snack, before or after training…), remove, rename and reorder them. Each meal has its own carb, protein and fat budget, and the meals always add up to the day.
- Home, the diary, the weekly menu, the reminders and the agent connector all use your meals.

**Overspending spread over the day**
- If a meal goes over on a macro, the extra is taken off the meals still ahead that day (on by default, can be turned off in Points). The planned menu is not changed.

**Travel mode**
- One tap on Home pauses the menu, the shopping list and their reminders, and optionally household sync and per-meal budgets, so you only log what you eat. It can end on a date you choose. Configurable in Settings.

**Menu and recipe importer**
- Paste a menu as text or a table, open a text or CSV file, or take a photo. EatPoint finds the days, meals and foods in English or Spanish and matches each food to your foods or the food databases. Missing amounts are fitted to each meal's points.
- Optional reading with your configured AI provider, which asks first and sends only that text or photo.

**Weekly menu calendar**
- A month view with the points planned each day, whether it was logged, and a preview of the day.

**Setup**
- A new "Your points" step suggests a daily budget (a guide only), lets you pick the method and the number of meals, and turns on overspend spreading.

**New look**
- New launch animation with the EatPoint logo, a new Android 12+ splash, and no logos or names from the original app left in the interface. Settings → About credits OpenNutriTracker.

## Coming next
- A downloadable food database of basic foods and supermarket products, cleaned and adapted to points, available during setup or from Settings.
- More languages, with label and menu reading in each.
- On-device AI model, more scripts and alphabets in the scanner, and Google Drive for the household.

## Downloads
- `EatPoint-0.2.0-arm64-v8a.apk`: for almost every phone from the last few years.
- `EatPoint-0.2.0-universal.apk`: for any Android 8.0+ device.
